clauses.title: Scope – Requirements, and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements, and the methods of sampling and test for preformed rigid polyurethane (PUR) and polyisocyanurate (PIR) foam for thermal insulation in the form of boards, cut and moulded slabs, cut and moulded pipe sections, cut and moulded radiused and bevelled lags, panels with adhesive integrally laminated facings, panels with adhesive applied facings, and cut and moulded special shapes.

clauses.title: Type – The rigid
clauses.text: 2.1 Type - The rigid preformed cellular urethane thermal insulation materials shall be of two types: Type 1 - For general use. Type 2 -  For use where there is a requirement for greater resistance to compressive forces.

clauses.title: Grades – The rigid
clauses.text: 2.2 Grades - The rigid preformed cellular urethane thermal insulation materials shall be of two grades: PUR -  Rigid polyurethane foam whose maximum recommended operating temperature is up to 110ºC. PIR -  Rigid polyisocyanurate foam whose maximum recommended operating temperature is up to 140ºC.

clauses.title: Compositions – Shall consist
clauses.text: 3.   Compositions -  Shall consist of rigid polyurethane or rigid polyisocyanurate foam with substantially closed cell structure.

clauses.title: Requirements – Shall conform
clauses.text: 4.   Requirements -  Shall conform to the requirements given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Standard Sizes and Dimensions
clauses.text: 5. Standard Sizes and Dimensions -  In the case of finished boards of both the types, the sizes shall be either 1.0 × 0.5 m or 1.22 ×  0.61 m or as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. The size for pipe-section and lags shall be 1.0 or 0.5 m length unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier, and the bore shall be the specified outside diameter of the pipe to be lagged.

clauses.title: Thickness
clauses.text: 5.1 Thickness — The material shall normally be supplied in thickness  of 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90 and 100 mm or as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: 6.1 General  — Shall not have visible defects that would adversely affects its service qualities.

clauses.title: Pipe Sections
clauses.text: 6.2 Pipe Sections — Shall be supplied in two semicircular pieces; the longitudinally mating faces shall be flat and in the same plane so that when the two pieces are put together no gaps exist between the mating surfaces. Note — It is common practice for the mating faces while still being flat in the length-wise direction to have a variable profile in the radial direction. This is acceptable provided that the mating surfaces so created still fits snugly together. In many cases, this practice enchances the snugness of the fit.

clauses.title: The ends shall be
clauses.text: 6.2.1 The ends shall be flat and normal to the Note 1- For notes on guidance to user/designers refer to Appendix A of the standard. Note 2- For method of tests, refer to IS 3346 : 1980 Method of  determination of  thermal conductivity of thermal insulation material (two slab guarded hot plate method) (first revision) and relevant parts of IS 11239 : 1985 Method of test for  cellular thermal insulating materials. For detailed information, refer to IS 12436 : 1988  Specifications for Preformed rigid polyurethane (PUR) and polyisocyanurate (PIR) foams for thermal insulation. longitudinal axis of the sections.

clauses.title: Radiused and Bevelled Lags
clauses.text: 6.3 Radiused and Bevelled Lags - The mating bevelled edges shall be flat, so that when they are put together to form a cylinder no gaps exists between abutting lags.

clauses.title: The ends shall be
clauses.text: 6.3.1 The ends shall be flat and normal to the longitudinal axis of the lag. Note — No values are specified for their width on the outer and inner faces.

clauses.title: Moulded Components – All
clauses.text: 6.4 Moulded Components - All moulded items shall be free from grease or other mould release agent that will adversely reduce the adhesion of insulation, mastics and adhesives.

clauses.title: Colour Identification – PIR
clauses.text: 6.5 Colour Identification - PIR foam shall be supplied coloured pink. PUR foam shall be supplied in any other colour or without added colour, as required.
